units.source_text: 不久之后，源氏抱着小皇子说：“右大将生了许多儿子，

en.t: Before long, Genji held the little prince in his arms and said, "The Captain of the Right has had many sons,

units.source_text: 至今没有让我见过这些孙子，我常引为憾。

en.t: but to this day he has never let me see those grandsons, and I have always regretted it.

units.source_text: 且喜有了这个可爱的外孙。”

en.t: Still, I am glad to have this dear little grandson through my daughter."

units.source_text: 他疼爱这小皇子，原是理之当然。

en.t: It was only natural that he should cherish the little prince.

units.source_text: 小皇子像春笋一般日夜长大。

en.t: The little prince grew day and night like a spring bamboo shoot.

units.source_text: 乳母暂时不用不熟悉的新人，而从原有的侍女中选择人品优越的人来充任。

en.t: For the time being, they did not use unfamiliar new women as nurses, but chose women of excellent character from among the attendants already in service.

units.source_text: 明石夫人为人聪明、高尚而大方，

en.t: Lady Akashi was intelligent, noble-minded, and generous in character,

units.source_text: 应该谦逊的地方，态度非常谦逊，从来不对人生气或骄傲，

en.t: and wherever humility was called for, she was extremely modest, never becoming angry with others or acting proud,
so there was no one who did not praise her.

units.source_text: 紫夫人以前偶尔和明石夫人会面，与她不甚相容，

en.t: Lady Murasaki had occasionally met Lady Akashi before and had not been especially close to her,

units.source_text: 现在托小皇子之福，明石夫人受她重视，两人就非常亲昵了。

en.t: but now, thanks to the little prince, Lady Akashi was valued by her, and the two became very intimate.
Lady Murasaki loved children by nature,

units.source_text: 亲手替小皇子制造“天儿”，即放在枕边可以驱邪避凶的人像，真可谓不失童心。

en.t: and with her own hands she made an "amatsu-ko" for the little prince, a doll placed by the pillow to ward off evil and misfortune; truly, she had not lost her childlike heart.

units.source_text: 她朝朝暮暮为抚养小皇子而忙碌。

en.t: Morning and evening, she busied herself with raising the little prince.

units.source_text: 那位老迈的尼姑不能从容地看看这小外曾孙，心甚不满。

en.t: The elderly nun was deeply dissatisfied that she could not take her time looking at this little great-grandson through her granddaughter.

units.source_text: 她只匆匆看见几面，别后想念甚苦，几乎为此丧命。

en.t: She had only glimpsed him hurriedly a few times, and after parting from him she missed him so painfully that she nearly lost her life over it.
